title: Xbox to cap Cloud Gaming hours for Game Pass subscribers
description: Game Pass subscribers will no longer have unlimited access to Xbox's Cloud Gaming service.

title: Supercell's acquisition of Metacore expected to close this month
description: Once the deal is closed, Merge Mansion will officially become part of Supercell's live games portfolio.

title: Gamecity Hamburg launches second round of prototype funding
description: The organization is offering up to €80,000 to developers based or operating in the region.

title: CD Projekt Red won't be abandoning physical releases
description: 'What you can definitely expect from us is to put out a box that's going to make it worth your while.'

title: Nexus Mods is acquiring database and analytics site SteamDB
description: Nexus Mods wants to grant SteamDB resources and the 'long-term stability it deserves.'

title: Report: Savvy Games Group CEO Brian Ward departs company
description: 'As Savvy embarks on its next period of transformational growth, this is the right time for new leadership for that evolution.'

title: The majority of Doom: The Dark Ages' DLC got made 'in three or four months'
description: The team reportedly worked 60 to 80 hour weeks to get the project out the door.

title: Aggro Crab launches publishing label to splash that Peak cash
description: The studio wants to support 'intense, stylized games with an attitude' - but isn't interested in 'generative AI slop.'

title: Sega-owned Rovio is shutting down its Copenhagen studio
description: The closure follows the cancellation of Sonic Blitz and the exact number of redundancies are yet to be confirmed.

title: Paradox Interactive's Afterworld wants to entice new players to grand strategy with tasty RPG hooks
description: Game director Dan Lind explains the appeal of strategy in grand strategy games, and how to invite new players into a sprawling game.

title: Star Wars Zero Company studio furloughed workers ahead of launch
description: Bit Reactor has confirmed it temporarily suspended workers without pay due to concerns over how its debut title would perform.

title: Housemarque co-founder Ilari Kuittinen exits from studio
description: 'Strive to be a better professional, and a better human being.'

title: Report: 13TB of Steam data leaked after users access 'publicly accessible endpoint'
description: The leaked data apparently includes beta builds and screenshots of pre-release Valve titles—and games from other publishers like EA and WB Games.

title: Indie devs and publishers hit in Gamescom equipment thefts
description: Thieves obtained access to Gamescom's Indie Arena and business area and stole a number of laptops and Steam Decks from smaller exhibitors.

title: GDC Side Quest - Inside Austin Wintory's Collaborative Composing Process
description: This month, celebrated composer Austin Wintory joins content marketing manager Beth Elderkin for a conversation about his creative process.

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
